name: Parental Discipline
overview: Scripture teaches that parental discipline is an expression of love and wisdom, intended to guide children away from folly and toward righteousness. The Proverbs emphasize the necessity of timely correction, warning that sparing the rod is harmful, while proper chastening cleanses and reforms the heart. Training a child in the right way ensures lasting obedience, as early discipline shapes character and preserves hope for the child's future.
